technical_quality: Adequate PA film; L marker at image upper right confirms conventional orientation. Adequate penetration (spine visible through mediastinum) and inspiration (right hemidiaphragm ~9th posterior rib); minimal rotation. Large bilateral breast shadows overlie the lower zones and partially reduce contrast there.

devices.type: surgical clips (3 small linear metallic densities, one folded/double-line)
devices.location: patient right apex / right upper zone, at the level of the 1st-2nd ribs

devices.type: external L side marker with technologist initials
devices.location: image upper right corner (patient left shoulder region), outside the thorax

abnormalities.finding: Large lobulated dense mass contiguous with the left hilum/mediastinum, ~10 cm, convex well-defined upper-lateral margin against aerated left upper lobe; extends inferiorly into the lower zone (labelled pulmonary mass)

Homogeneous dense opacity in the left lower zone contiguous with the hilar mass, silhouetting the left heart border and medial left hemidiaphragm (mass extension and/or left lower lobe collapse/consolidation); left costophrenic angle only partially visible
Left hilar enlargement / apparent widening of the left mediastinal contour, likely part of the mass or associated lymphadenopathy
Residual aerated left upper lobe appears relatively hyperlucent (probable compensatory hyperinflation)

description_zh: 正面胸部X光（PA），左側標記位於影像右上方，定位正常。左側肺門區可見一大型、邊緣分葉狀之緻密腫塊影，約10公分，與縱膈相連並向外側及下方延伸至左中下肺野，遮蔽左心緣及左橫膈內側，左上肺野殘餘肺組織相對透亮。右肺尖可見三枚手術夾，右肺野餘清晰，右橫膈及右肋膈角清楚。未見胸管、引流管、心律調節器或血管導管等裝置；雙側乳房陰影重疊於下肺野。
